record_scope_reconstruction: Zokhawthar–Rikhawdar/Khawmawi crossing over Tiau River. This is the named bridge gate with adjacent connections, not all India–Myanmar frontier. Limited April 20 medical/student/essential access does not imply normal travel.

Governor visit directly describes existing Friendship Bailey Bridge at Zokhawthar LCS.
